integration_issues.issue: In this headless preview clicking spl-toggle-btn did NOT surface data-testid='spl-error' within 3.5s (the getUserMedia call did not reject fast enough or was silently accepted by fake device). The page did NOT crash and spl-value remained mounted, so the core resilience requirement is satisfied — but the intended 'Permiso denegado' UX path could not be visually validated in this environment.

Could not exercise compare-spl-grids / compare-grid-a / compare-grid-b / compare-grid-delta because no scenes exist in this session (Convex offline + saveScene input not reachable on /export in this preview). Only the empty state (compare-empty-cta) was verified. Main agent already validated via 78/78 vitest — recommend adding a Playwright scene-seeder via zustand persist localStorage for future regression coverage.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider seeding demo scenes into the store on first load (or exposing a testid-friendly 'Guardar' flow at /export) so future testing agents can exercise the compare-spl-grids path without a live Convex backend.

critical_code_review_comments: src/components/soundmap/spl-meter.tsx L44-49: the useEffect that pushes readings into recorderRef fires on EVERY reading.spl/peak change. If the recorder session is long (>1h) and the meter emits at ~10 Hz, that's 36 000+ re-renders due to setRecTick. The recTick guard exists only to trigger re-render for liveSummary — consider throttling recTick updates to once per second (e.g. only when Math.floor(durationSec) changes) so the summary indicator UI does not re-render on every audio frame. Non-blocking but a real perf cliff on long sessions.

src/components/soundmap/optimizer-modal.tsx L27-57: the useEffect depends on [open, room, tops, subs] and re-runs optimizeStage 144-permutation search whenever room/tops/subs identity changes even if the modal is still open with the same intent. Because tops/subs are arrays from the zustand store, any store update (e.g. a Convex sync tick) will re-key them and re-trigger the 144-config search mid-modal. Consider snapshotting the inputs on open (useMemo keyed only on `open`) so an ongoing optimization is not restarted by upstream store churn.

src/pages/compare/index.tsx L104-118: sceneToSources builds sources at every render because gridA/gridB useMemo deps are [a] / [b] — but sceneToSources allocates the array inline; identity of `a` from `scenes.find(...)` changes on each scenes-array update (Convex sync). Not currently expensive (16×22 grid), but on larger grids this would recompute unnecessarily. Consider memoizing on a stable scene id.

src/pages/compare/index.tsx L215-234 & 231-235: `canShowDelta === false` string check uses a triple-equal with a variable that is a boolean|memoized value; the `null` case (either grid missing) is not surfaced to the user (falls through to `null`). A user with A having gear and B without gear will see grid_a rendered, grid_b's HeatmapCard shows 'Sin equipo', and NO delta/nope message — minor UX polish opportunity: show an inline hint 'Falta equipo en B para calcular el delta'.

src/components/soundmap/spl-meter.tsx L60-68: toggleRecording early-returns with toast when state !== 'running', BUT session-rec-btn is only rendered when isRunning (L301). The guard is dead code — safe but confusing (probably intended as defense-in-depth). Non-blocking.

src/components/soundmap/optimizer-modal.tsx L41-48: optimizeStage runs on the main thread with async yields. In the preview it completed in ~2 s for 144 configs at 12×16 grid, which is fine. On mobile Safari with older devices (iPhone SE class) 144 × spl-grid computation may take 5-8 s — consider adding a bail-out button that lets the user cancel mid-search (the `cancelled` flag exists but is only wired to the unmount path, not exposed to the UI).
